entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for UE transitioning from 5G NAS (N1 mode) to EPS NAS (S1 mode) in EMM-IDLE mode, involving PDU session to EPS bearer context mapping and attach/tracking area update procedures.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for UE transitioning from EPS NAS (S1 mode) to 5G NAS (N1 mode) in 5GMM-IDLE mode, involving EPS bearer context to PDU session mapping and registration procedures.

entities.name: EPS attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to attach to EPS network, potentially including PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST with handover request types for PDU session transfer.

entities.name: Tracking area update procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to update its tracking area in EPS network.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: 5G NAS procedure for mobility and periodic registration update with mobility registration updating indication.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: 5G NAS procedure for establishing PDU sessions with various request types including existing PDU session, existing emergency PDU session, MA PDU request, and initial request.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST message
entities.description: EPS NAS message used for network attachment, potentially containing PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for PDU session transfer.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
entities.description: ESM message used to request PDN connectivity with request types including handover and handover of emergency bearer services.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: 5GMM message used for registration procedures with 5GS registration type IE indicating mobility registration updating.

entities.name: Request type handover
entities.description: Condition where request type is set to 'handover' for transferring non-emergency PDU sessions from N1 mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: Request type handover of emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where request type is set to 'handover of emergency bearer services' for transferring emergency PDU sessions from N1 mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: Interworking without N26 interface supported
entities.description: Condition where UE has received indication from network that interworking without N26 interface is supported.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EPS NAS state entered during inter-system change procedures.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: 5G NAS state entered during inter-system change procedures.

entities.name: Registration attempt counter reset
entities.description: Property where UE resets registration attempt counter for 3GPP access after successful procedure completion.

relations.description: Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode includes EPS attach procedure when conditions are met.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode includes tracking area update procedure when conditions are not met for handover.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode includes registration procedure for mobility registration updating.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode includes PDU session establishment procedure for PDN connection transfer.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for PDU session transfer.
EPS attach procedure uses request type 'handover' for non-emergency PDU session transfer.
EPS attach procedure uses request type 'handover of emergency bearer services' for emergency PDU session transfer.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode requires interworking without N26 interface supported indication for handover procedures.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode establishes 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
Successful EPS attach procedure establishes registration attempt counter reset property.
Successful registration procedure establishes registration attempt counter reset property.
